list.noUnitsDescription: Create a Unit to start autonomous development

form.description: A Unit is the team that runs an operation: it pairs a worker runtime with the Sidekick packages assigned to each phase and the subagents delegated within them. Tasks are assigned to a Unit to run under these settings.
form.name: Name

runtime.title: Runtime
runtime.agentDefsError: Failed to load agent definitions. Command preview and generic/launchable detection may be unavailable.
runtime.workerRuntimeHint: How the worker process is launched and managed.
runtime.executionModeHint: Determines how the worker's turn completion is detected.

phases.title: Phases
phases.description: Toggle a phase off to skip it, or pin it to a specific Sidekick package instead of the phase default. Only Sidekicks carrying that phase's tag are selectable.

subagents.title: Subagents
subagents.reviewDescription: Delegate code review to a separate agent instead of self-review.
subagents.implementDescription: Delegate implementation work to a separate agent instead of doing it directly.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.selfReviewHint: Default value for new tasks. Can be overridden per task.
advanced.systemPromptHint: The persona a task assumes while executing under this Unit.
